items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Now, the next session, that's right, you have Fred Robinson in place of Claude... and Bechet's out. [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: Uh-huh, he's living back in Cleveland now. I got his address too. I don't know whether he's records or not I'll get an answer from him, probably mail him one. He had made records with Jelly before with the Red Hot Peppers in Chicago. Then when he came to New York, he was working on the subway. I don't know whether he was -- I think he was a conductor. Yeah, I think he must have retired because Fred went back to Cleveland.
Well, he must be getting on by now, anyway.
